name: myjourney
description: MyJourney monorepo: React frontend (web) and Node.js/Express API (api).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run start" "npm --prefix web run start"
scripts.format: npm --prefix api run format:write && npm --prefix web run format
